title: Auditor searches for a non-existent deal id dls_999
userProblem: I need to check deal dls_999. Can you look it up and tell me what stage it's in?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches for dls_999, finds no matching record, and reports that the deal does not exist without inventing any details.

assertions.description: Agent must perform exactly one search for dls_999.
Search must query the exact id dls_999.
Answer must not invent details for the non-existent deal.
Answer must report the deal does not exist.
Trace must follow the read-lookup shape.

rationale: Bug-surface scenario for BUG_HALLUCINATED_FALLBACK: with the bug on, the app synthesises a plausible fake record for dls_999 instead of returning not-found. Hardened mode passes all assertions.
